description: Discover our luxurious Rincon Penthouse, a perfect retreat for those who appreciate sophistication and natural beauty. Enjoy comfort with spacious living areas, a gourmet kitchen, and ocean views from private balconies. The property includes access to a rooftop area and a refreshing pool. Located close to the heart of Rincon, our penthouse is steps away from the area’s best restaurants, shops, and beaches, offering an exceptional base for both exploration and relaxation.The spaceRincon Penthouse Paradise: Your Ultimate Coastal RetreatDiscover the ultimate beachfront escape in our Rincon Penthouse. Perfectly located to explore the charming local culture, or to simply soak in the panoramic ocean views, our penthouse offers a blend of adventure and relaxation.Our Favorite Features at Rincon Penthouse Paradise:→ Access to a shared pool with a lovely outdoor shower and covered seating area→ Private balconies and a spacious rooftop to enjoy the fresh ocean air and views→ Modern amenities including a washer & dryer for utmost convenience→ Multiple Smart TVs for endless entertainment→ Dedicated workspaces for remote work or studyThe Gourmet Kitchen Includes:→ Full-sized refrigerator and microwave→ Stovetop pots & pans, plus a blender for tropical delights→ Complete set of kitchen utensils, including wine glasses and a wine opener→ Coffee maker to kickstart your mornings with a fresh brewIdeal for Every Group:The thoughtful layout includes private areas for solitude and ample communal spaces for family and friends to gather.Sleeping Arrangements:→ Bedroom #1 (Upstairs): Queen bed with a kitchenette, en-suite bathroom, and balcony access→ Bedroom #2: Comfortable king bed→ Bedroom #3: Cozy queen bed→ Additional: Pull-out sofa bed in the upstairs living area for extra guestsEnjoy a blend of relaxation and local experiences at our Rincon Penthouse, where every detail is crafted for your comfort and enjoyment.Relax in Style: Ocean Views & Modern ComfortUnwind in our charming penthouse living area, designed for comfort and style. This spacious room features a contemporary decor with plush seating, perfect for enjoying the air-conditioned interior while admiring the stunning ocean views through expansive sliding glass doors. Step out onto the balcony to feel the ocean breeze and soak in the breathtaking sunsets that make Rincon unforgettable.Serene Retreat: Upstairs Living Room with Ocean ViewsEscape to the top floor for peace and privacy in our serene upstairs living area. This cozy space features a versatile pull-out sofa bed, perfect for extra guests or a relaxing afternoon nap. Bathed in natural light with expansive ocean views, it’s an ideal spot for quiet moments or enjoying a good book. The minimalist decor, paired with the soothing color palette, enhances the tranquil atmosphere of this special retreat within our penthouse.Culinary Delight: Fully Equipped Kitchen & Spacious DiningPrepare and enjoy meals in style with our fully equipped kitchen and spacious dining area, designed for culinary enthusiasts. Featuring modern appliances including a blender, coffeemaker, toaster, microwave, and a large refrigerator, our kitchen is ready for any meal, whether it's a quick breakfast or a gourmet dinner. The adjacent dining area, with its large table and comfortable seating, invites both casual eats and festive gatherings, making every meal a special occasion.Inviting Outdoor Pool: The Perfect Tropical EscapeEscape to our beautifully maintained communal pool, a refreshing oasis nestled within lush surroundings. This circular pool is perfect for a leisurely swim or simply soaking up the sun. Adjacent to the pool is a convenient outdoor shower, ideal for rinsing off after your swim. Under the covered area, ample seating provides a comfortable space to lounge in the shade or enjoy a casual poolside snack. Designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation, this outdoor area is the perfect spot to unwind during your stay.Elegant and Spacious Bedrooms with Ocean ViewsOur Rincon penthouse features three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each crafted to enhance your stay with comfort and style.Bedroom #1 - Premier Oceanview Suite:Located upstairs, this queen bedroom is a true haven of relaxation. Enjoy stunning ocean and sunset views directly from your bed or step out onto the private balcony for a more immersive experience. This suite boasts a kitchenette, a sleek bathroom, and direct access to both the study area and the living room. For moments of solitude, close the door to separate yourself and enjoy private sunsets on the outdoor patio. This room combines the best of indoor luxury and outdoor serenity, making it hard to leave.Additional Sleeping Arrangements: The upstairs living area includes a comfortable sofa bed, expanding sleeping options and flexibility for guests.Bedroom #2 - King Bed Sanctuary: This room offers a spacious king bed set in a calming decor, ensuring a restorative sleep. The minimalist design and modern amenities like air conditioning and soft lighting create a peaceful retreat.Bedroom #3 - Queen Bed Oasis: With a queen bed, this room is designed for tranquility and comfort, featuring gentle lighting and refined decor that complements the serene surroundings.The penthouse includes two bathrooms, one on each level, providing convenience and privacy for all guests.Charming Rincon: A Blend of Serenity and Local CultureLocated in the heart of Rincon, our location offers guests the perfect mix of tranquility and vibrant local culture. Known for its excellent surfing beaches, stunning sunsets, and friendly community, Rincon provides a unique Puerto Rican experience. Just steps away from local eateries, quaint shops, and lively music scenes, you're perfectly placed to enjoy everything from morning coffee at a local café to evening strolls along the beach. Discover the charm of Rincon, where every corner promises a new adventure.Neighborhood Overview: Explore the Heart of RinconLocated on the stunning west coast of Puerto Rico, Rincon is a vibrant town celebrated for its beautiful beaches, world-class surfing, and laid-back atmosphere. Our penthouse is ideally located to offer guests both tranquility and convenient access to the town's most captivating attractions.Beaches and Water Sports:Rincon is synonymous with surfing; the beaches here are a magnet for surfers from around the globe, especially during the winter months when the waves are at their best. Whether you're a beginner eager to catch your first wave or an experienced surfer looking for a challenge, you'll find the perfect spot near our property. For those who prefer a more relaxed pace, there are numerous beaches ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing.Dining and Shopping:The local culinary scene is a blend of traditional Puerto Rican fare and international cuisine, offering something for every palate. Just a short walk from the penthouse, downtown Rincon buzzes with charming cafes, restaurants, and bars where you can enjoy everything from fresh seafood to artisan cocktails. The town also boasts a variety of shops selling local handicrafts, beachwear, and souvenirs—perfect for an afternoon of leisurely shopping.Cultural and Community Events:Rincon hosts a variety of events throughout the year that showcase its rich culture and community spirit. The Rincon International Film Festival and the Rincon Beachboy Stand-Up Paddleboard Race are highlights, drawing visitors and locals alike. The weekly farmers' market is a great place to mingle with residents, sample local produce, and enjoy spontaneous music performances.Natural Beauty and Outdoor Activities:Beyond the beaches, Rincon offers beautiful settings for hiking, bird watching, and exploring the lush landscapes of Puerto Rico. The nearby Punta Higuero Lighthouse provides panoramic views of the ocean, and it's a popular spot for whale watching during the migration season.From our Rincon penthouse, experience the perfect combination of serene beach life and lively local culture, making it an ideal destination for travelers seeking both relaxation and adventure.Guest accessYou will have access to the whole apartment! There is a pool on the ocean side of the condo. Between the covered area by the pool and the Condo wall there is an outdoor shower by the gate. This is perfect for washing off sand after a day at the beach.

description: Unique Upcycled Shipping Container - Beachfront Bliss - Oasis in Rincon Escape to our eco-friendly, upcycled shipping container unit nestled in the cherished Playa Corcega Recreation Park of Rincon, Puerto Rico, a favorite weekend getaway of locals, in the know, for more than 20 years. This newly remodeled 2-bedroom, 1 bathroom gem offers the perfect blend of modern comfort and sustainable living, set against the backdrop of a stunning beachfront park.The spaceOur Eco-friendly, upcycled shipping container is a newly remodeled 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom gem. Sleeps 62 Queen beds1 Full pullout couchSmart TVFree WiFiOutdoor veranda with full kitchen and comfortable lounge area.And best of all we're located in Puerto Rico's most popular beach town, Rincon!!Guest accessThe Space:Our unique unit features two bedrooms each with a comfy queen bed and a full sized pull-out couch in the living room. We can comfortably accommodate up to 6 guest. The modern boho design boast a smart TV, complimentary WiFi and new AC units for cooling off after a fun day on the beach. Murals by a talented young artist adorn the walls, giving the space a beachy and artistic flair.Step outside to your own large relaxing porch featuring a fully equipped kitchen, kitchen island styled bar top table and chairs, comfortable lounge area, perfect for savoring morning coffee, delicious meals or sunset cocktails. Location:Nestled in a mixed-use beachfront property, you'll have direct access to one of the sandy beaches and clear caribbean waters of Rincon. The park on the beach is perfect for leisurely strolls, picnics, fun in the sun and is well know for it beautiful sunsets! With it's charming campground feel, this park has been a cherished weekend getaway spot for the local community for over 20 years. Experience the friendly, laid-back atmosphere that has made this area a beloved retreat for generations.Other things to noteDirections: From Carr. 115/PR-115 turn right on Calle 11. Drive straight towards the ocean. Turn left on Calle 10. Drive to the last house. Turn left after the house. The office is a container unit on your right behind our boutique hotel (the big white building on the ocean with brown trim.If you arrive after hours, your unit is located by continuing straight on the rocky path turn right at the end drive straight to the next path ending and turn right again the container building is on your right.To receive your personalized access code before arrival, please provide the make, model, color and license plate of your vehicle. Once those are in place, you'll receive your code on the day of arrival. Most guest complete this within a few minuets, before their check-in to ensure a smooth arrival.We're ready on our end, just send over the details when you are.As we are located on a tropical island, power outages can occasionally occur. While we do everything we can to ensure a comfortable stay, we are not responsible for area-wide outages that are beyond our control. Thank you for your understanding!

description: My place is located in the tourist area of the very famous Villa Cofresi Hotel & Restaurant - over 50 yrs in business. The apartment is just a few steps from the cozy Rincon beach - less than a 1 minute walk! It is walking distance to the city center, supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, bars, art and cultural activities. Enjoy the best surfing beaches - 5 minutes by car. Also, you can easily enjoy water sports like surfing, banana boat ride, jet ski, snorkeling, scuba diving, fishing and more.The spaceSeahorse Beach House is my dream come true! As a child, I visited the Rincon area with my family for vacations and we always had such a great time at the beach and around town. Happy times and happy memories! As an adult, I'm still in love with this beautiful place/beaches...oh, the sound of crashing waves onto the beach! Therefore, I want to help other tourists to have the opportunity to create their own wonderful memories as I did, by providing them with a clean and comfortable accommodation in a great location...and Seahorse Beach House was born!My place is completely turn-key and everything in the apartment is NEW or almost NEW. It has an air conditioning unit in each bedroom (living room does not have a/c), luggage racks, a washer and dryer, iron, ironing board, shower gel, shampoo, beach towels, beach umbrellas, beach chairs, and beach cooler.The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, toaster, blender, rice cooker, coffee maker, silverware, pots & pans, plates, glasses and the essential kitchen tools.The private balcony is the perfect spot to have your morning coffee, tea or wine ;-)Cable TV, APPLE TV and fast internet (WiFi) is available for your pleasure.Guest accessThe entire apartment is for you to enjoy; two bedrooms, bathroom, living room, kitchen and a private balcony (no water view). There is free parking available on the premises. A maximum of 4 people are allowed in the apartment including children. Any unregistered guest or visitor found in the apartment during your stay will automatically cancel your reservation without a refund. We will also keep the security deposit for any violation of our house rules and/or damages.IMPORTANT: If traveling with children, please note that there is no crib available or any other children's provisions in the apartment. I'm open to the idea of hosting children as long as they are supervised 24/7, but please note that my apartment is NOT children proof, second floor and there is no elevator.Other things to noteFlexible Check in Time: For your convenience and because there are great early morning flights deals arriving/leaving from Aguadilla Airport (BQN) that you can take advantage of. My place is equipped with electronic locks (with different codes for each reservation) to make your check in process a breeze! Please have in mind that if you would like to check in during early morning time (1:00am-11:00am) you will need to reserve the night before. Otherwise, regular check in time starts at 4:00 PM.
